minutes.headline: Committee approved capital request instructions for department heads and set an Oct 20 meeting on policy and special town meeting.
minutes.summary: The Capital Planning Committee approved the capital request instructions and rating criteria to send to department heads, with returns wanted by October 22nd. They discussed whether to endorse deferred projects for the November 17 special town meeting and scheduled a meeting for October 20 on the capital threshold policy and that recommendation. Members also elected a vice chair while saying they were stretched thin and that a member was missing.

budget_items.what_was_said: A warrant article would amend the capital plan to include the projects not funded in May, minus the trackless piece of equipment.

Chapter 70 and unrestricted aid figures and assessments have been provided, but the state budget and federal stimulus decisions remain uncertain.
A member asked what has been funded and purchased from last year and earlier; the town manager said the list is being updated.

what_happened.line: The Capital Planning Committee approved the capital request instructions and rating criteria to send to department heads.
Department heads were asked to return capital requests by October 22nd.
The committee set a meeting for October 20 at 5:30 on the capital threshold policy and the special town meeting recommendation.
Members discussed a warrant article to add projects not funded in May, minus the trackless equipment, to the capital plan for the November 17 special town meeting.
Members nominated Tom Alonzo as vice chair, and the nomination passed.

why_it_matters: The instructions and scoring criteria set how departments' capital requests are ranked, which shapes which projects reach Town Meeting and what borrowing or tax funding voters may be asked to approve.
The deferred projects from May could come back as a warrant article at the November 17 special town meeting, where residents would vote, and state aid remained uncertain.
